T: Same wedding. Same day. Different snacks.
D: Two strangers get stuck reliving the same wedding day in Palm Springs over and over.
P: Serve the snacks when Nyles floats in the pool on his pizza float.
S: Nyles floating in the pool on a pizza float, forever
Pizza dough rolled thin, cut into rounds, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 220C for 10 minutes.
the wedding reception in the desert
Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and chives, beside wedges of rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto.
Nyles and Sarah's dance at the desert bar
Halved jalapeños filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked until crisp.
M: another sunny day in Palm Springs
White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, in warm tortillas with slaw, lime crema and pickled onion.
the wedding dinner they eat every day
Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a lemon butter sauce and potatoes.
W: the same wedding cake, every day
Lemon sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes, filled with lemon curd and cream, iced white.
K: Cold lager straight from the esky, or lemonade with lime over ice.

s.note: Nyles floating in the pool on a pizza float, forever
s.how: Roll pizza dough thin and cut into small rounds. Top each with a spoon of pizza sauce, grated mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake at 220C for 10 minutes until crisp and bubbling. Eat them floating in the pool, again and again.

s.note: Nyles and Sarah's dance at the desert bar
s.how: Halve 12 large jalapeños lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Mix 200g cream cheese with 80g grated cheddar and fill each half. Wrap with half a rasher of streaky bacon and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

m.note: another sunny day in Palm Springs
m.how: Dust 600g white fish in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Quickly pickle sliced red onion in lime juice. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, fish, crema and pickled onion.

w.note: the same wedding cake, every day
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream and ice white. Serve it today, and probably tomorrow, and the day after that.

d.how: Fill an esky with ice and cold water and bury the bottles for 30 minutes. Hand out cold lager for the grown-ups, and pour lemonade over ice with a squeeze of lime for everyone else. Drink it on a pool float in the desert sun.
